en.s: The Battle of Gaugamela ( GAW-gə-MEE-lə; Ancient Greek: Γαυγάμηλα, romanized: Gaugámēla, lit. 'the Camel's House'), also called the Battle of Arbela (Ἄρβηλα, Árbēla), took place in 331 BC between the forces of the Army of Macedon under Alexander the Great and the Persian Army under King Darius III. It was the second and final battle between the two kings, and is considered to be the final blow to the Achaemenid Empire, resulting in its complete conquest by Alexander.

zh.s: 高加米拉战役又称阿贝拉战役，发生于公元前331年。亚历山大大帝率领马其顿军队与波斯国王大流士三世统领的波斯军队交战。这是两位国王之间的第二场、也是最后一场战役，被视为阿契美尼德帝国遭受的最后重创，亚历山大随后彻底征服该帝国。高加米拉在古希腊语中意为“骆驼之家”。

en.t: Damasus I is consecrated bishop of Rome
en.s: On October 1, 366, Damasus I was consecrated bishop of Rome at the Lateran basilica. His accession took place amid a violent dispute with supporters of the rival claimant Ursinus.
en.n: The date follows the historical chronology, without conversion to the modern Gregorian calendar.

zh.t: 达玛苏一世在罗马接受主教祝圣
zh.s: 366年10月1日，达玛苏一世在罗马拉特朗大殿接受主教祝圣。他的就任伴随着激烈争执，其支持者与另一位教宗候选人乌尔西努斯的支持者发生了暴力冲突。
zh.n: 日期沿用历史记载中的历法，未换算为现代公历。

en.t: Edgar becomes king of all England
en.s: On October 1, 959, Edgar became king of the whole of England after the death of Eadwig. His later coronation was a separate event.
en.n: The date follows the source’s historical chronology; this is the succession, not the later coronation.

zh.t: 埃德加成为全英格兰国王
zh.s: 959年10月1日，埃德维格去世，埃德加继位，成为整个英格兰的国王。他的加冕典礼在此后举行。
zh.n: 日期沿用来源所列的历史纪年。这里记录继位，并非后来的加冕。

en.t: John XIII is consecrated as pope
en.s: On October 1, 965, John XIII was consecrated as pope after being unanimously elected. The choice followed negotiations between the Roman nobility and Emperor Otto I’s envoys after the death of Leo VIII.
en.n: The date follows the source’s historical chronology. The ceremony’s precise venue is not confirmed in the retained account.

zh.s: 965年10月1日，若望十三世在获一致推选后祝圣就任教宗。良八世去世后，罗马贵族与奥托一世皇帝的使节经过协商，选定了他。
zh.n: 日期沿用来源所列的历史纪年，仪式的确切地点尚未确认。

en.t: Battle of the Col de Panissars
en.s: The Battle of the Col de Panissars was fought on 30 September and 1 October 1285 between the forces of Philip III of France and Peter III of Aragon. It was a severe defeat for the French, who were already retiring over the Pyrenees when the Aragonese fell on them.

zh.s: 帕尼萨尔山口战役于1285年9月30日至10月1日发生，交战双方是法国腓力三世与阿拉贡的佩德罗三世所率部队。法国军队遭到惨败，当时他们已开始撤过比利牛斯山，随后被阿拉贡军队袭击。

en.s: The Barbary Crusade, also called the Mahdia Crusade, was a Franco-Genoese military expedition in 1390 that led to the siege of Mahdia, then a stronghold of the Barbary pirates in Hafsidi Ifriqiya (geographically corresponding to modern Tunisia). Froissart's Chronicles is the chief account of what was one of the last crusades.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 巴巴里十字军东征又称马赫迪耶十字军东征，是1390年法兰西和热那亚联合发动的一次军事远征，最终围攻了马赫迪耶。该城当时是哈夫斯王朝伊夫里基亚地区（地理范围大致相当于今天突尼斯）的巴巴里海盗据点。弗鲁瓦萨尔编年史是记述这场十字军东征的主要史料；它也是最后几次十字军东征之一。
zh.n: 此条采用原文资料框列出的事件结束日期。

en.s: The battle of Alboran (Spanish: batalla de Alborán) took place on 1 October 1540 off the isle of Alboran during the Ottoman–Habsburg struggle for control of the Mediterranean when a Spanish fleet under the command of Bernardino de Mendoza destroyed an Ottoman fleet commanded by Ali Hamet, sinking a galley and capturing 10 other ships.

zh.s: 阿尔沃兰海战（西班牙语：batalla de Alborán）于1540年10月1日在阿尔沃兰岛附近爆发，发生于奥斯曼帝国与哈布斯堡王朝争夺地中海控制权期间。贝尔纳迪诺·德·门多萨率领的西班牙舰队击败阿里·哈梅特指挥的奥斯曼舰队，击沉一艘桨帆船并俘获另外10艘船。

en.s: The coronation of Mary I as Queen of England and Ireland took place at Westminster Abbey, London, on Sunday 1 October 1553. This was the first coronation of a queen regnant in England, a female ruler in her own right. The ceremony was therefore transformed. Ritual and costume were interlinked. Contemporary records insist the proceedings were performed "according to the precedents", but mostly these were provisions made previously for queens consort.

zh.s: 1553年10月1日星期日，玛丽一世在伦敦威斯敏斯特教堂加冕为英格兰和爱尔兰女王。这是英格兰首次为女性君主举行加冕礼，因此仪式作了调整。仪式流程和服饰彼此关联。当时的记录称典礼“依照先例”举行，但大多数先例实际上是为王后加冕时预先制定的。

en.t: Abbas I is crowned in Qazvin
en.s: On October 1, 1588, Abbas I was crowned shah in Qazvin after his father, Mohammad Khodabanda, handed him the royal insignia. He was seventeen years old.
en.n: The date follows the chronology given by Encyclopaedia Iranica.

zh.t: 阿拔斯一世在加兹温加冕
zh.s: 1588年10月1日，阿拔斯一世在加兹温加冕为沙阿。他的父亲穆罕默德·胡达班达将王权象征交给他，当时他十七岁。
zh.n: 日期沿用《伊朗百科全书》所列的纪年。

en.s: The Capture of Bacharach took place on October 1, 1620 at Bacharach, Electorate of the Palatinate. The conflict was between the Spanish forces commanded by Don Gonzalo Fernández de Córdoba and the Protestant forces of Frederick V, Elector Palatine, during the Palatinate campaign in the context of the Thirty Years' War. After a quick start of the invasion of states of Frederick V, proclaimed King of Bohemia, the operations slowed in mid-September, after the Capture of Oppenheim. Don Ambrosio Spinola, the Spanish general in command, assessed at a council of war the choice between undertaking the siege of Heidelberg or, secondarily, the town of Bacharach.

zh.s: 1620年10月1日，普法尔茨选侯国的巴哈拉赫被攻占。交战双方是唐·贡萨洛·费尔南德斯·德·科尔多瓦指挥的西班牙军队，以及普法尔茨选侯腓特烈五世的 新教军队；这场战斗发生在三十年战争期间的普法尔茨战役中。入侵腓特烈五世领地（他自称波希米亚国王）起初进展很快，但9月中旬攻下奥彭海姆后，军事行动放缓。西班牙主将唐·安布罗西奥·斯皮诺拉召集军事会议，商议是否围攻海德堡，或改攻巴哈拉赫镇。

en.s: The Battle of Gniew or the Battle of Mewe was fought during the Polish–Swedish War (1626–1629), between Sweden and the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth from 22 September with initial skirmishes, to the main battle of 1 October 1626. Both the Swedish and Polish army were commanded by their kings – Gustavus Adolphus of Sweden and Sigismund III Vasa. The battle ended with a victory for Sweden. However Polish and Swedish armies had different objectives. The Sigismund Vasa wanted to protect Gdańsk from besieging. Gustav had to protect Gniew, which was importance of prestige for his army.

zh.s: 格涅夫战役又称梅韦战役，发生于波兰—瑞典战争（1626—1629年）期间。双方从9月22日开始发生零星冲突，并于1626年10月1日展开主战。瑞典和波兰军队分别由国王古斯塔夫二世·阿道夫和齐格蒙特三世·瓦萨统领，战役以瑞典获胜告终。不过，双方目标不同：齐格蒙特·瓦萨想保护正在遭受围攻的格但斯克，古斯塔夫则要保住格涅夫，因为这关系到其军队的声望。

en.t: Ahmed III is forced to abdicate as the Ottoman sultan
en.s: Ahmed III (Ottoman Turkish: احمد ثالث, Aḥmed-i sālis; Turkish: III. Ahmed; 30 December 1673 – 1 July 1736) was sultan of the Ottoman Empire and a son of sultan Mehmed IV (r. 1648–1687). His mother was Gülnuş Sultan, originally named Evmania Voria, who was an ethnic Greek. He was born at Hacıoğlu Pazarcık, in Dobruja. He succeeded to the throne in 1703 on the abdication of his brother Mustafa II (1695–1703).

zh.t: 奥斯曼苏丹艾哈迈德三世被迫退位
zh.s: 艾哈迈德三世（1673年12月30日—1736年7月1日）曾任奥斯曼帝国苏丹。他是苏丹穆罕默德四世的儿子，母亲是原名埃夫马尼娅·沃里亚的居尔努什苏丹，具有希腊族血统。艾哈迈德出生于多布罗加的哈吉奥卢帕扎尔哲克。1703年，兄长穆斯塔法二世退位后，他继承了苏丹之位。

en.s: The Battle of Lobositz or Lovosice also Lowositz on 1 October 1756 was the opening land battle of the Seven Years' War. Frederick the Great's 28,000 Prussians were prevented by 33,000 Austrians under Maximilian Ulysses Count von Browne from continuing their invasion into the rich Bohemian plain, forcing Frederick to ultimately fall back north into Saxony for the winter.

zh.s: 洛沃西采战役又称洛沃西策战役，于1756年10月1日打响，是七年战争的首场陆战。奥地利军队由马克西米连·乌利塞斯·冯·布朗伯爵率领，共3.3万人，阻止了腓特烈大帝率领的2.8万普鲁士军队继续入侵富庶的波希米亚平原，迫使腓特烈最终在冬季退回萨克森北部。

en.s: On October 1, 1779, King Gustav III of Sweden granted Tampere its town charter. The city, in present-day Finland, celebrates this date as its anniversary.
en.n: The country identifies the city being established.

zh.t: 坦佩雷获颁城市特许状
zh.s: 1779年10月1日，瑞典国王古斯塔夫三世向坦佩雷颁发城市特许状。这座位于今天芬兰的城市将这一天作为建城纪念日。
zh.n: 国家标注的是所建立城市的位置。

en.s: The 1794 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on October 1, 1794, in order to elect the Governor of Connecticut. Incumbent Federalist Governor of Connecticut Samuel Huntington won re-election as he ran unopposed.

zh.s: 1794年10月1日，康涅狄格州举行州长选举。联邦党籍现任州长塞缪尔·亨廷顿没有对手，成功连任。

en.t: The French Convention decrees the annexation of the Austrian Netherlands
en.s: On October 1, 1795, the French National Convention adopted a decree incorporating the Austrian Netherlands and neighbouring territories into the French Republic. Administrative integration continued afterwards.
en.n: The date corresponds to 9 Vendémiaire, Year IV, in the French Republican calendar.

zh.t: 法国国民公会颁令将奥属尼德兰并入法国
zh.s: 1795年10月1日，法国国民公会通过法令，将奥属尼德兰及周边领地并入法兰西共和国。后续行政整合仍继续进行。
zh.n: 这一天对应法国共和历四年葡月九日。

en.s: The Battle of Glarus (also variously known as the Combat of Näfels and the Combat of Netstal) was a meeting engagement fought on 1 October 1799. The battle ended the Austro-Russian invasion of the Helvetic Republic, which was the last campaign that involved the Russian commander Alexander Suvorov. The French (Gabriel Molitor's brigade and Honoré Gazan's division) were led by Jean-de-Dieu Soult.

zh.s: 格拉鲁斯战役又称内费尔斯战斗或内斯塔尔战斗，是1799年10月1日发生的一场遭遇战。战役结束了奥俄联军对赫尔维蒂共和国的入侵，也是俄罗斯指挥官亚历山大·苏沃洛夫最后一次参与的战役。法军由让-德-迪厄·苏尔特指挥，部队包括加布里埃尔·莫利托的旅和奥诺雷·加赞的师。

en.s: The Third Treaty of San Ildefonso was a secret agreement signed on 1 October 1800 between Spain and the French Republic by which Spain agreed in principle to exchange its North American colony of Louisiana for territories in Tuscany. The terms were later confirmed by the March 1801 Treaty of Aranjuez.

zh.t: 第三次圣伊尔德丰索条约
zh.s: 1800年10月1日，西班牙与法兰西共和国秘密签署第三次圣伊尔德丰索条约。西班牙原则上同意以其北美殖民地路易斯安那换取托斯卡纳的领土。条约条件后来于1801年3月的《阿兰胡埃斯条约》中得到确认。

en.t: Delaware's at-large congressional district special election, 1805
en.s: A special election was held in Delaware's at-large congressional district on October 1, 1805 to fill a vacancy resulting from the resignation of James A. Bayard (F) upon election to the Senate. Bayard had earlier served in the House in the 5th, 6th, and 7th Congresses before being narrowly defeated for re-election in 1802 by Caesar A. Rodney, whom he, in turn, defeated in 1804.

zh.t: 1805年特拉华州联邦众议院全州选区特别选举
zh.s: 1805年10月1日，特拉华州全州选区举行特别选举，以填补詹姆斯·A·贝亚德（联邦党）辞职后留下的空缺。贝亚德因当选参议员辞去了众议院席位。他此前曾在第五、第六和第七届国会任职，1802年竞选连任时以微弱差距败给凯撒·A·罗德尼，1804年又击败罗德尼。

en.s: The siege of Ragusa took place in 1806 during the Napoleonic Wars (the War of the Third Coalition in a certain period). After French occupied the maritime republic of Ragusa, Russian and allied forces under the leadership of Vice Admiral Dmitry Senyavin laid siege to it for months. The Russian allies included Montenegrins, commanded by the Orthodox bishop of Montenegro, Petar I Petrović-Njegoš.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1806年拿破仑战争期间，拉古萨围城战爆发，当时正值第三次反法同盟战争的一个阶段。法国占领拉古萨海上共和国后，德米特里·谢尼亚温海军中将率领俄军及盟军围城数月。俄军盟友包括黑山人，他们由黑山东正教主教彼得一世·彼得罗维奇-涅戈什统领。
zh.n: 此条采用原文资料框列出的事件结束日期。

en.s: The capture of the Jeune Richard was the result of a naval engagement that took place in the Caribbean on 1 October 1807, during the Napoleonic Wars, between the British packet ship Windsor Castle, and the French privateer Jeune Richard. In an unequal battle, the Windsor Castle, under the command of her acting-captain William Rogers, not only defended repeated attacks from the privateer, but finally engaged her, boarded her and after overpowering the much larger crew, forced them below decks and took the privateer as their prize. The victory was widely reported in contemporary papers and journals, Rogers and his crew were hailed as heroes and lavishly rewarded for their valour.

zh.s: 1807年10月1日，拿破仑战争期间，加勒比海发生了一场海战，英国邮船“温莎城堡”号与法国私掠船“青年理查德”号交战，最终后者被俘。实力悬殊的情况下，由代理舰长威廉·罗杰斯指挥的“温莎城堡”号不仅挡住对方多次进攻，还主动接战并登上对方船只。他们压制住人数多得多的船员，将其赶到甲板下，并俘获了这艘私掠船。胜利的消息当时广为报道，罗杰斯及其船员被誉为英雄，并因英勇表现获得丰厚奖赏。

en.s: The Battle of Vilcapugio (Quechua: Sacred Well) was an action fought on October 1, 1813 during the second Campaign of Upper Peru in the Argentine War of Independence, where the republican forces led by General Manuel Belgrano were defeated by a royalist army, led by Joaquin de la Pezuela.

zh.s: 维尔卡普吉奥战役发生于1813年10月1日，是阿根廷独立战争中上秘鲁第二次战役的一部分。曼努埃尔·贝尔格拉诺将军率领的共和派军队被华金·德·拉·佩苏埃拉领导的保王党军队击败。维尔卡普吉奥在克丘亚语中意为“神圣之泉”。

en.s: The Congress of Vienna of 1814–1815 was a series of international diplomatic meetings to discuss and agree upon a possible new layout of the European political and constitutional order after the downfall of the French emperor Napoleon Bonaparte. Participants were representatives of all European powers (other than the Ottoman Empire) and other stakeholders. The Congress was chaired by Austrian statesman Klemens von Metternich (Duke Metternich) and was held in Vienna from September 1814 to June 1815.
en.n: The Congress of Vienna opens with the intention of redrawing Europe's political map after the defeat of Napoleon in the previous spring.

zh.s: 1814至1815年的维也纳会议是一系列国际外交会议，旨在讨论并商定拿破仑·波拿巴败亡后欧洲政治和宪政秩序的新格局。参加者包括欧洲各国（奥斯曼帝国除外）的代表和其他利益相关方。会议由奥地利政治家克莱门斯·冯·梅特涅（梅特涅公爵）主持，于1814年9月至1815年6月在维也纳举行。此次会议开幕时，各方计划在拿破仑于前一年春季战败后重新划定欧洲政治版图。
zh.n: 此次会议开幕时，各方计划在拿破仑于前一年春季战败后重新划定欧洲政治版图。

en.s: The 1816 Delaware gubernatorial election was held on October 1, 1816. The Federalist former representative from New Castle County John Clark defeated the Democratic-Republican candidate Manaen Bull.

zh.s: 1816年10月1日，特拉华州举行州长选举。来自新卡斯尔县的前联邦党众议员约翰·克拉克击败民主共和党候选人马纳恩·布尔。

en.s: On 1 October 1818, approximately six Wodiwodi people were killed in a clash with nine settlers from the Colony of New South Wales along the Minnamurra River in the Illawarra, New South Wales. The settlers claimed to have been attempting to recover two muskets which had been lent to some of the Aboriginal people which escalated into an armed clash.

zh.s: 1818年10月1日，新南威尔士殖民地的九名移民者在新南威尔士州伊拉瓦拉明纳穆拉河沿岸与沃迪沃迪族人发生冲突，约六名沃迪沃迪族人被杀。移民者声称，他们原本只是想取回借给部分原住民的两支滑膛枪，结果冲突升级为武装交火。

en.s: The 1822 Delaware gubernatorial special election was held on October 1, 1822. A little more than a year into his three-year term, Democratic-Republican Governor John Collins died in office, elevating State Senate Speaker Caleb Rodney, a Federalist, to the governorship and triggering a special election for a three-year term in 1822. Former Governor Joseph Haslet ran as the Democratic-Republican nominee against James Booth, the Federalist nominee.

zh.s: 1822年10月1日，特拉华州举行州长特别选举。民主共和党州长约翰·柯林斯三年任期刚过一年多便在任内去世。联邦党州参议院议长凯勒布·罗德尼继任州长，由此触发为期三年的州长特别选举。前州长约瑟夫·哈斯莱特代表民主共和党参选，对阵联邦党候选人詹姆斯·布思。

en.s: The 1827 Georgia gubernatorial election was held on October 1, 1827, to elect the governor of Georgia. Due to the death of the Democratic-Republican Clark candidate Matthew Talbot, Jacksonian Troup candidate John Forsyth won in a landslide against a divided opposition.

zh.s: 1827年10月1日，佐治亚州举行州长选举。民主共和党克拉克派候选人马修·塔尔博特去世后，杰克逊派特鲁普候选人约翰·福赛思在反对派分裂的情况下以压倒性优势获胜。

en.s: The capture of Erivan (or Erevan/Yerevan; Persian: فتح ایروان, romanized: Fath e Iravān; Russian: Взятие Эривани, romanized: Vzyatie Ėrivani) took place on 1 October 1827, during the Russo-Persian War of 1826–28. The city fell to the Russians after being besieged for a week and opened up the path for the eventual capture of Tabriz, the second largest city in Iran and an important trading post.

zh.s: 埃里温攻占战又称埃里凡／埃里温攻占战（波斯语：فتح ایروان，罗马化：Fath e Iravān；俄语：Взятие Эривани，罗马化：Vzyatie Ėrivani），发生于1827年10月1日，是1826—1828年俄波战争的一部分。俄军围城一周后攻陷该城，为最终攻占伊朗第二大城市和重要贸易据点大不里士打开了道路。

en.s: The Battle of Kroyo was an engagement of the Java War which took place on 1 October 1828 near the village of Kroyo in Purworejo, in modern Central Java. A Dutch column, pursuing a small group of Javanese rebels, encountered a much larger force than they had expected, and was destroyed in a later ambush.

zh.s: 克罗亚战役是爪哇战争期间的一场交战，于1828年10月1日在今中爪哇普沃雷佐的克罗亚村附近发生。一支荷兰纵队正在追击一小股爪哇叛军，却遭遇远超预期的敌军，随后在伏击中全军覆没。

en.s: The Battle of Maella was a battle of the First Carlist War, occurring on October 1, 1838, near the Aragonese town of Maella. The battle was a Carlist victory and resulted in the routing of most of the Liberal forces. The Carlist forces were composed of some 3,500 infantrymen and 500 cavalry. The Liberals counted on some 5,000 infantry and 300 cavalry. During the fighting, Ramón Cabrera was wounded in the arm but led a desperate cavalry charge, raising the morale of his forces and throwing the Liberal forces into disarray. The Liberal forces counterattacked, throwing the Carlist left guard into disarray.

zh.s: 马埃利亚战役是第一次卡洛斯战争中的一场战斗，发生于1838年10月1日，地点在阿拉贡城镇马埃利亚附近。卡洛斯派获胜，大部分自由派部队溃败。卡洛斯派约有3500名步兵和500名骑兵，自由派则有约5000名步兵和300名骑兵。拉蒙·卡布雷拉在战斗中手臂受伤，但仍率领骑兵发起孤注一掷的冲锋，鼓舞己方士气并打乱自由派阵线。自由派随后反击，又打乱了卡洛斯派左翼。

en.t: Lord Auckland issues the Simla Declaration
en.s: On October 1, 1838, Governor-General Lord Auckland issued the Simla Declaration, announcing British support for restoring Shah Shuja to the Afghan throne and criticising Dost Mohammad Khan.
en.n: This records the declaration, not the start of a battle or the army’s entry into Afghanistan.

zh.t: 奥克兰勋爵发布《西姆拉宣言》
zh.s: 1838年10月1日，印度总督奥克兰勋爵发布《西姆拉宣言》，宣布英国支持沙阿·舒贾恢复阿富汗王位，并批评多斯特·穆罕默德汗。
zh.n: 这里记录宣言发布，并非战斗开始或军队进入阿富汗。

en.s: The second capture of Chusan (Chinese: 第二次定海之戰) occurred on 1 October 1841 during the First Opium War when British forces captured the city of Dinghai, capital of the Chusan (Zhoushan) islands off the east Chinese coast. The fortified city of Dinghai, with a population of 30,000, was defended by the Chinese under the command of Keo.

zh.s: 第一次鸦片战争期间，1841年10月1日，英军攻占了中国东海岸舟山群岛首府定海，这是第二次攻占舟山（中文：第二次定海之战）。定海是一座有防御工事的城市，人口约3万，由中国军队驻守，守将名为柯奥。

en.s: On October 1, 1841, Peruvian troops led by President Agustín Gamarra began marching toward Bolivia. They crossed the border the following day and entered La Paz on October 15.

en.s: The Battle of the Volturno refers to a series of military clashes between Giuseppe Garibaldi's volunteers and the troops of the Kingdom of Two Sicilies occurring around the River Volturno, between the cities of Capua, Santa Maria Capua Vetere and Caserta in northern Campania, in September and October 1860. The main battle took place on 1 October 1860 between 30,000 Garibaldines (mostly defected Sicilians, including from Calabria) and 25,000 Bourbon troops (Neapolitans).

zh.s: 沃尔图诺河战役是朱塞佩·加里波第志愿军与两西西里王国军队之间的一系列军事冲突，发生于1860年9月至10月，地点在坎帕尼亚北部、卡普阿、圣玛丽亚卡普阿韦泰和卡塞塔等城之间的沃尔图诺河一带。主战于1860年10月1日打响，参战的加里波第军约3万人（大多是倒戈的西西里人，包括来自卡拉布里亚的士兵），波旁王朝那不勒斯军队约2.5万人。

en.s: The Battle of Vaughan Road, also spelled "Vaughn", was an American Civil War engagement between Confederate States Army and Union Army cavalry forces protecting the flank of the main Union attack on Confederate positions on the western end of the Confederate line on October 1, 1864 during the Battle of Peebles' Farm, part of the Siege of Petersburg. The Union force repulsed Confederate attacks and protected ground just gained at McDowell's Farm and an important road junction on the Vaughan Road at the Wyatt Road. They inflicted about 130 casualties on the Confederates while losing about 90 men, about half of whom were taken prisoner.

zh.s: 沃恩路战役又拼作“Vaughn”，是美国内战期间的一场交战，发生于1864年10月1日彼布尔斯农场战役期间，属于彼得斯堡围城战的一部分。联邦军骑兵保护主攻部队的侧翼，后者正在进攻邦联军西段阵地。联邦军击退邦联军进攻，守住了刚在麦克道尔农场夺取的阵地，以及沃恩路与怀亚特路交叉口这一重要路口。邦联军约有130人伤亡，联邦军约损失90人，其中约一半被俘。

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held in 1889, in eleven states. Virginia holds its gubernatorial elections in odd numbered years, every 4 years, following the United States presidential election year. New Jersey at this time held gubernatorial elections every 3 years. It abandoned this practice in 1949. Massachusetts and Rhode Island both elected their respective governors to a single-year term. They abandoned this practice in 1920 and 1912, respectively. Iowa and Ohio at this time held gubernatorial elections in every odd numbered year. Mississippi at this time held its gubernatorial elections in odd numbered years, every 4 years, following the United States presidential election year. This was the last election in which this was the case. Mississippi switched to four-year terms with elections in the year preceding the presidential election year, starting with the 1895 elections. Montana, North Dakota, South Dakota, and Washington held their first gubernatorial elections on achieving statehood. Each of these states held early elections on October 1, 1889.

zh.s: 1889年，美国有11个州举行州长选举。弗吉尼亚州在总统选举后的奇数年举行州长选举，每四年一次。新泽西州当时每三年举行一次州长选举，直到1949年才改制。马萨诸塞州和罗得岛州的州长任期当时均为一年，分别于1920年和1912年改制。爱荷华州和俄亥俄州当时每逢奇数年举行州长选举。密西西比州当时也在总统选举后的奇数年每四年举行一次州长选举；1889年是这一安排下的最后一次选举。该州从1895年起改为四年一届，并在总统选举前一年的奇数年举行选举。蒙大拿、北达科他、南达科他和华盛顿四州于建州时首次举行州长选举，并都在1889年10月1日提前举行了选举。

en.s: On October 1, 1890, an Act of Congress established Yosemite National Park in California. Yosemite Valley and the Mariposa Grove had already received protection in 1864 and were incorporated into the national park in 1906.

en.s: On October 1, 1891, Stanford University opened to students on the Stanford family’s Palo Alto farm in California. Leland and Jane Stanford had founded the university in 1885 in memory of their son.

en.s: The Los Angeles Times bombing was the purposeful dynamiting of the Los Angeles Times building in Los Angeles, California, on October 1, 1910 by a union member belonging to the International Association of Bridge and Structural Iron Workers. The explosion started a fire which killed 21 newspaper employees and injured 100 more. It was termed the "crime of the century" by the Times. Brothers John J. ("J.J.") and James B. ("J.B.") McNamara were arrested in April 1911 for the bombing. Their trial became a cause célèbre for the American labor movement. J.B. admitted to setting the explosive, and was convicted and sentenced to life in prison.

zh.s: 1910年10月1日，国际桥梁与结构铁工协会的一名工会成员在加利福尼亚州洛杉矶故意炸毁《洛杉矶时报》大楼。爆炸引发火灾，造成21名报社员工死亡、100多人受伤。《洛杉矶时报》将其称为“世纪罪案”。1911年4月，约翰·J.（“J.J.”）和詹姆斯·B.（“J.B.”）·麦克纳马拉兄弟因爆炸案被捕。他们的审判成为美国劳工运动中的重大事件。J.B.承认放置炸药，被判有罪并处以终身监禁。

en.s: The First Battle of Torreon, also known as the Capture of Torreon, which lasted from September 27 to October 1, 1913, was one of the battles of the Mexican Revolution, where revolutionaries led by Pancho Villa occupied a city protected by Huertist federal forces. The victory in his first large battle of the Mexican Revolution brought Villa not only a huge increase in prestige, but also considerable spoils of war in the form of urgently needed military equipment of all kinds.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 托雷翁第一次战役又称托雷翁攻占战，发生于1913年9月27日至10月1日，是墨西哥革命中的一场战役。潘乔·比利亚领导的革命者占领了由韦尔塔派联邦军守卫的城市。比利亚在墨西哥革命中的首场大规模战役中获胜，声望大增，也缴获了各类急需的军事装备。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: The Metamorphosis written by Franz Kafka is published in the German journal Die Weißen Blätter
en.s: The Metamorphosis (German: Die Verwandlung, pronounced [dɪ fɛɐ̯ˈvantlʊŋ]), also translated as The Transformation, is a novella by Franz Kafka published in 1915. One of Kafka's best-known works, The Metamorphosis tells the story of salesman Gregor Samsa, who wakes to find himself inexplicably transformed into a huge insect (German: ungeheueres Ungeziefer, lit. 'monstrous vermin') and struggles to adjust to this condition, as does his family.

zh.t: 弗朗茨·卡夫卡的《变形记》发表于德国期刊《白色书页》
zh.s: 《变形记》（德语：Die Verwandlung，也译作《蜕变》）是弗朗茨·卡夫卡于1915年发表的中篇小说，也是他最著名的作品之一。小说讲述推销员格里高尔·萨姆沙一觉醒来，发现自己 莫名其妙地变成了一只巨大的虫子（德语 ungeheueres Ungeziefer，字面意为“怪异的害虫”），随后努力适应这种处境；他的家人也同样难以适应。

en.s: The Capture of Damascus marked a victory of the British and Arab armies in their campaign against the Ottoman empire in the Middle Eastern theatre of World War I. The capture took place on 1 October 1918 after the capture of Haifa and the victory at the Battle of Samakh which opened the way for the pursuit north from the Sea of Galilee and the Third Transjordan attack which opened the way to Deraa and the inland pursuit, after the decisive Egyptian Expeditionary Force (EEF) victory at the Battle of Megiddo during the Sinai and Palestine campaign of World War I.

zh.s: 攻占大马士革是英国和阿拉伯军队在一战中东战场对奥斯曼帝国作战的一场胜利。1918年10月1日，大马士革被攻占。此前，英军攻下海法，并在萨马克战役获胜，为从加利利海向北追击打开通道；第三次外约旦攻势则打开了通往德拉和内陆追击的道路。此前，埃及远征军在西奈和巴勒斯坦战役中的米吉多战役取得决定性胜利。

en.t: Battle of the Canal du Nord
en.s: The Battle of Canal du Nord was part of the Hundred Days Offensive of the First World War by the Allies against German positions on the Western Front. The battle took place in the Nord-Pas-de-Calais region of France, along an incomplete portion of the Canal du Nord and on the outskirts of Cambrai between 27 September and 1 October 1918.

zh.s: 北运河战役是第一次世界大战协约国百日攻势的一部分，目标是打击西线的德军阵地。战役于1918年9月27日至10月1日在法国北部加来海峡地区进行，地点沿未完工的北运河一带及康布雷郊外。

en.t: Georges Carpentier knocks out Joe Beckett in the first round
en.s: On October 1, 1923, Georges Carpentier knocked out Joe Beckett in the first round of their heavyweight boxing match at Olympia in London.

zh.t: 卡彭蒂埃首回合击倒乔·贝克特
zh.s: 1923年10月1日，乔治·卡彭蒂埃在伦敦奥林匹亚举行的重量级拳击比赛中，于第一回合击倒乔·贝克特获胜。

en.s: The Küstrin Putsch of 1 October 1923, also known as the Buchrucker Putsch after its leader, was a coup attempt against the Weimar Republic by units of the paramilitary Black Reichswehr under Bruno Ernst Buchrucker. It was launched in response to nationalist anger over the government's decision to end passive resistance against the French and Belgian occupation of the Ruhr.

zh.s: 屈斯特林政变又称布赫鲁克政变，以领导人布鲁诺·恩斯特·布赫鲁克命名，是魏玛共和国时期的一次政变企图，发生于1923年10月1日。参与者是布赫鲁克率领的黑色国防军准军事部队。政变是对政府决定停止抵抗法国和比利时占领鲁尔区的回应，此决定激起了民族主义者的愤怒。

en.s: The 1928 Nova Scotia general election was held on 1 October 1928 to elect members of the 39th House of Assembly of the province of Nova Scotia, Canada. It was won by the Liberal-Conservative party.

zh.s: 1928年10月1日，加拿大新斯科舍省举行大选，选出该省第39届议会的议员。自由保守党获胜。

en.s: On October 1, 1928, Newark Metropolitan Airport opened in Newark, New Jersey. It later became Newark Liberty International Airport.
en.n: The airport opened under the name Newark Metropolitan Airport.

zh.t: 纽瓦克大都会机场启用
zh.s: 1928年10月1日，纽瓦克大都会机场在美国新泽西州纽瓦克启用，后来更名为纽瓦克自由国际机场。
zh.n: 机场启用时的名称是纽瓦克大都会机场。

en.s: Georgia Democrats held a gubernatorial primary runoff after the initial vote produced no majority in the county unit system.
en.n: Party nomination runoff.

zh.t: 佐治亚州举行民主党州长初选决选
zh.s: 1930年，佐治亚州民主党举行州长初选决选。此前的首轮投票中，没有候选人赢得郡单位制所需的多数票。
zh.n: 这是党内提名的第二轮投票。

en.s: The Australian Labor Party held a leadership election on 1 October 1935, following the resignation of James Scullin. John Curtin was elected as his replacement, defeating Frank Forde and Norman Makin, and consequently became Leader of the Opposition.

zh.s: 1935年10月1日，澳大利亚工党举行党魁选举，接替辞职的詹姆斯·斯卡林。约翰·柯廷击败弗兰克·福德和诺曼·马金，当选新党魁，并因此成为反对党领袖。

en.t: Catalonia’s Central Committee of Anti-Fascist Militias dissolves
en.s: On October 1, 1936, the Central Committee of Anti-Fascist Militias of Catalonia dissolved itself. Some representatives of the committee joined the Catalan government.
en.n: The announcement abolishing the committee and its dissolution were separate steps.

zh.t: 加泰罗尼亚反法西斯民兵中央委员会自行解散
zh.s: 1936年10月1日，加泰罗尼亚反法西斯民兵中央委员会自行解散，部分代表加入加泰罗尼亚政府。
zh.n: 宣布废止委员会与委员会自行解散，是两个不同的步骤。

en.t: Franco receives head-of-state powers in Burgos
en.s: On October 1, 1936, Francisco Franco received head-of-state powers from the National Defence Junta at a ceremony in Burgos. The transfer took place within the Nationalist rebel administration during the Spanish Civil War.
en.n: The appointment decree was dated September 29; the transfer ceremony followed on October 1.

zh.t: 弗朗哥在布尔戈斯接掌国家元首职权
zh.s: 1936年10月1日，弗朗西斯科·弗朗哥在布尔戈斯的仪式上，接过国防委员会移交的国家元首职权。这次权力移交发生在西班牙内战中的国民军阵营内部。
zh.n: 任命法令签发于9月29日，权力移交仪式于10月1日举行。

en.s: The battle of Wytyczno took place on October 1, 1939 near the village of Wytyczno near Włodawa in Poland. It was a struggle between the Polish forces of the Border Defence Corps of Gen. Wilhelm Orlik-Rückemann and the Soviet Red Army during the invasion of Poland. After the battle of Szack on September 28, the Polish commander decided to cross the Bug River and continue the fight there. After a short rest, on September 30 the Poles had crossed the river. Although largely victorious in most of the fights against the Soviets, the Polish unit was reduced to merely 3,000 men and was lacking heavy equipment and ammunition.

zh.s: 维蒂奇诺战役于1939年10月1日在波兰弗沃达瓦附近的维蒂奇诺村一带发生。交战双方是威廉·奥尔利克-吕克曼将军领导的波兰边境防卫军，以及入侵波兰的苏联红军。9月28日沙茨克战役结束后，波兰指挥官决定渡过布格河继续作战。波军休整后于9月30日渡河。波军此前多次对苏作战并占上风，但部队已缩减到仅约3000人，且缺少重型装备和弹药。

en.t: The original Pennsylvania Turnpike opens to traffic
en.s: On October 1, 1940, the original Pennsylvania Turnpike opened to traffic. The 160-mile road connected Carlisle and Irwin in Pennsylvania.
en.n: The opening covered the original route, not the entire present-day turnpike system.

zh.t: 宾夕法尼亚收费公路首段通车
zh.s: 1940年10月1日，宾夕法尼亚收费公路最初的路段通车，全长160英里，连接该州的卡莱尔和欧文。
zh.n: 当天开放的是最初的路段，并非今天的整个收费公路系统。

en.s: Convoy HG 73 (17 September – 1 October 1941) was a trade convoy of merchant ships during the Second World War. It was the 73rd of the numbered HG convoys Homeward bound to the British Isles from Gibraltar. The convoy departed from Gibraltar on 17 September 1941. A German reconnaissance aircraft spotted the convoy on 18 September and it was attacked over the next ten days.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: HG 73号船队（1941年9月17日至10月1日）是二战期间的一支商船运输船队，属于从直布罗陀返航不列颠群岛、以HG编号的第73支船队。船队于1941年9月17日离开直布罗陀，次日被德国侦察机发现，随后十天内遭到袭击。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Cape Burnas was a naval engagement between the Soviet and Romanian navies near the Burnas Lagoon in October 1942. On 1 October 1942, the Soviet M-class submarine M-118 attacked and sank the German transport ship Salzburg, which was carrying on board 2,000 Soviet prisoners of war. After attacking, the submarine was located by a German BV 138C flying boat, and the Romanian gunboats Sublocotenent Ghiculescu and Stihi Eugen were sent to the scene.

zh.s: 1942年10月，苏联海军与罗马尼亚海军在布尔纳斯潟湖附近交战。10月1日，苏联M级潜艇M-118袭击并击沉德国运输船“萨尔茨堡”号，船上载有2000名苏联战俘。袭击后，一架德国BV 138C水上飞机发现了潜艇，罗马尼亚炮舰“吉库莱斯库副尉”号和“斯蒂希·尤金”号奉命赶往现场。

en.s: The Battle of Rzhev in the summer of 1942 was part of a series of battles that lasted 15 months in the center of the Eastern Front. It is known in Soviet history of World War II as the first Rzhev–Sychyovka offensive operation, which was defined as spanning from 30 July to 23 August 1942.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1942年夏季的勒热夫战役，是东线中部一系列持续15个月的战斗之一。苏联二战史将它称为第一次勒热夫—瑟乔夫卡进攻行动，并将其时间界定为1942年7月30日至8月23日。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: Hoxha declares an end to cooperation with Balli Kombëtar
en.s: On October 1, 1943, Enver Hoxha wrote to the Albanian Communist Party’s Central Committee, declaring that cooperation with Balli Kombëtar was over and calling for action against it.
en.n: This records the dated letter, rather than claiming that all civil-war fighting began that day.

zh.t: 霍查宣布结束与巴利·库姆贝塔尔的合作
zh.s: 1943年10月1日，恩维尔·霍查致信阿尔巴尼亚共产党中央委员会，宣布与巴利·库姆贝塔尔的合作已经结束，并要求对该组织采取行动。
zh.n: 这里记录有明确日期的信件，并不表示内战的所有交火都从当天开始。

en.s: The 1944 Svenska Cupen final took place on 1 October 1944 at Råsunda in Solna. It was contested between Allsvenskan sides IFK Norrköping and Malmö FF. IFK Norrköping played their second consecutive final and their second final in total, Malmö FF played their first cup final ever. Malmö FF won their first title with a 4–3 victory after extra time. 35,087 spectators attended the match which was the record for the Svenska Cupen Final, until the 2026 final.

zh.s: 1944年瑞典杯决赛于1944年10月1日在索尔纳的罗斯达球场举行，由瑞典足球超级联赛球队北雪平和马尔默对阵。北雪平连续第二次、也是历史上第二次打进决赛；马尔默则首次参加杯赛决赛。马尔默在加时赛后以4比3获胜，首次夺冠。现场观众35,087人，创下瑞典杯决赛观赛人数纪录，该纪录保持至2026年决赛。

en.s: Operation Undergo was an attack by the 3rd Canadian Infantry Division on the German garrison and fortifications of the French port of Calais, during September 1944. A subsidiary operation was executed to capture German long-range, heavy artillery at Cap Gris Nez, which threatened the sea approaches to Boulogne. The operation was part of the Clearing the Channel Coast undertaken by the First Canadian Army, following the success of Operation Overlord and the break-out from Normandy.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1944年9月，加拿大第3步兵师向法国港口加来发动攻击，目标是德军驻军和防御工事。这项行动的附属任务是在格里内角夺取德军远程重炮；这些火炮威胁着通往布洛涅的海上航道。此次行动属于第一加拿大军清理海峡沿岸行动的一部分，发生在“霸王”行动成功、盟军突破诺曼底之后。
zh.n: 此条采用原文资料框列出的事件结束日期。

en.t: The Nuremberg tribunal completes the reading of its judgment
en.s: On October 1, 1946, the International Military Tribunal in Nuremberg completed the reading of its judgment against the Nazi leaders on trial. The judgment had been read over two days, September 30 and October 1.
en.n: The death sentences were carried out later, on October 16.

zh.t: 纽伦堡国际军事法庭完成判决宣读
zh.s: 1946年10月1日，纽伦堡国际军事法庭完成对受审纳粹主要战犯的判决宣读。判决分两天宣读，时间为9月30日和10月1日。
zh.n: 死刑判决于此后的10月16日执行。

en.t: Thai authorities begin arresting the Army General Staff plotters
en.s: On October 1, 1948, Thai authorities began arresting officers involved in the Army General Staff plot against Plaek Phibunsongkhram’s government. The government had received advance warning of the plan.
en.n: The arrests began on this date and continued during the following days.

zh.t: 泰国当局开始逮捕陆军参谋本部政变策划者
zh.s: 1948年10月1日，泰国当局开始逮捕参与陆军参谋本部政变计划的军官。这些军官企图推翻銮披汶·颂堪政府，但政府已提前得知计划。
zh.n: 逮捕行动从这一天开始，此后几天仍在继续。

en.s: General elections were held in Japan on 1 October 1952. The result was a victory for the Liberal Party, which won 242 of the 466 seats. Voter turnout was 76.4%.

zh.s: 日本于1952年10月1日举行大选。自由党获胜，在国会466个席位中赢得242席。投票率为76.4%。

en.s: The Mutual Defense Treaty between the United States and the Republic of Korea (Korean: 대한민국과 미합중국간의 상호방위조약) is a treaty between South Korea and the United States signed on October 1, 1953, two months after the signing of the Korean Armistice Agreement which brought a halt to the fighting in the Korean War.

zh.s: 《美利坚合众国与大韩民国共同防御条约》（韩语：대한민국과 미합중국간의 상호방위조약）是韩国与美国之间的一项条约，于1953年10月1日签署，即《朝鲜停战协定》签署、朝鲜战争停止交战两个月后。

en.s: Operation Blue Bird was a mission carried out by France's foreign intelligence service, the SDECE, in 1956 during the second year of the Algerian War of Independence. Its aim was to turn several hundred Kabyle people against the Algerian resistance known as the National Liberation Front (FLN), with the hopes of creating a clandestine counter-resistance force. These Kabyle fighters were known as Force K.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1956年，法国对外情报机构SDECE开展蓝鸟行动，正值阿尔及利亚独立战争的第二年。行动意在争取数百名卡拜尔人倒向阿尔及利亚民族解放阵线（FLN）领导的抵抗力量的对立面，并组建秘密反抵抗力量。这些卡拜尔战士被称为K部队（Force K）。
zh.n: 此条采用原文资料框列出的行动结束日期。

en.t: On October 1, 1958, the agency was dissolved and its assets and personnel were transferred to the newly created National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA)
en.s: The National Advisory Committee for Aeronautics (NACA) was a United States federal agency that was founded on March 3, 1915, to undertake, promote, and institutionalize aeronautical research. On October 1, 1958, the agency was dissolved and its assets and personnel were transferred to the newly created National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA). NACA is an initialism, pronounced as individual letters rather than as a whole word, as was NASA during the early years after being established.

zh.t: 美国国家航空咨询委员会解散
zh.s: 美国国家航空咨询委员会（NACA）是美国联邦机构，成立于1915年3月3日，负责开展、推动并制度化航空研究。1958年10月1日，该委员会解散，资产和人员转交新成立的美国国家航空航天局（NASA）。NACA是首字母缩略词，需逐个字母读出；NASA成立初期也曾如此读法。

en.s: Independence Day is an annual public holiday in Nigeria observed on 1 October to commemorate the country's independence from the United Kingdom in 1960. It is celebrated nationwide with official ceremonies, military parades, cultural displays, and other public events. The holiday commemorates the formal transfer of sovereignty that took place in Lagos at midnight on 1 October 1960, when the Union Jack was lowered and replaced with Nigeria's green–white–green flag.

zh.s: 尼日利亚独立日是每年10月1日的公共假日，纪念该国于1960年脱离英国独立。全国各地会举行官方仪式、阅兵、文化展示等活动。1960年10月1日午夜，拉各斯正式移交国家主权；英国国旗降下，取而代之的是尼日利亚绿白绿三色旗。

en.t: The network now known as CTV begins its first full broadcasting season
en.s: On October 1, 1961, the Canadian television network now known as CTV began its first full broadcasting season. Initially, live transmission was limited to southern Ontario, while other areas received programmes on tape delay.
en.n: Some affiliated stations had begun broadcasting before the network’s launch.

zh.t: 今天的CTV电视网开始首个完整播出季
zh.s: 1961年10月1日，今天的加拿大CTV电视网开始首个完整播出季。起初，现场直播仅覆盖安大略省南部，其他地区通过录像延后播出节目。
zh.n: 部分加盟电视台在电视网开播前就已开始播出。

en.t: Southern Cameroons joins the Republic of Cameroon to form a federation
en.s: On October 1, 1961, the formerly British-administered Southern Cameroons joined the Republic of Cameroon to form the Federal Republic of Cameroon. Its two component states were known as East Cameroon and West Cameroon.
en.n: This records the union taking effect, not the earlier referendum.

zh.t: 南喀麦隆并入喀麦隆共和国，组成联邦
zh.s: 1961年10月1日，原由英国管理的南喀麦隆与喀麦隆共和国合并，组成喀麦隆联邦共和国。联邦的两个组成部分分别称为东喀麦隆和西喀麦隆。
zh.n: 这里记录合并生效，并非此前举行公投的日期。

en.s: The Defense Intelligence Agency (DIA) is an intelligence agency and combat support agency of the United States Department of Defense (DoD) specializing in military intelligence. A component of the Department of Defense and the Intelligence Community (IC), DIA informs national civilian and defense policymakers about the military intentions and capabilities of foreign governments and non-state actors.
en.n: The JCS published Directive 5105.21, "Defense Intelligence Agency" on August 1, and DIA began operations with a handful of employees in borrowed office space on October 1, 1961.

zh.t: 美国国防情报局开始运作
zh.s: 美国国防情报局（DIA）是美国国防部的情报与作战支援机构，专门负责军事情报。作为国防部和情报界（IC）的组成部门，国防情报局向国家文职和国防决策者提供外国政府及非国家行为体的军事意图和能力信息。参谋长联席会议于8月1日发布第5105.21号《国防情报局》指令；国防情报局于1961年10月1日在借用的办公场所内由少数员工开始运作。
zh.n: 参谋长联席会议于8月1日发布第5105.21号《国防情报局》指令；国防情报局于1961年10月1日在借用的办公场所内由少数员工开始运作。

en.s: The Tokaido Shinkansen (Japanese: 東海道新幹線; lit. 'Eastern Sea Road new main line') is a Japanese high-speed rail line and part of the nationwide Shinkansen network. Together with the San'yō Shinkansen, it forms a continuous high-speed corridor through the Taiheiyō Belt, also known as the Tōkaidō corridor. Opened in 1964 between Tōkyō and Shin-Ōsaka stations, it was the world's first high-speed rail line and remains one of the busiest.

zh.s: 东海道新干线（日语：東海道新幹線，意为“东海道新干线”）是日本高速铁路线路，属于全国新干线网络。它与山阳新干线相连，构成贯穿太平洋沿岸工业带（又称东海道走廊）的连续高速铁路通道。该线路于1964年开通，连接东京站与新大阪站，是世界首条高速铁路，至今仍是最繁忙的线路之一。

en.t: Six Indonesian army generals are killed in the September 30 Movement
en.s: In the early hours of October 1, 1965, members of the September 30 Movement killed six Indonesian army generals in Jakarta, including Army Commander Ahmad Yani. General Abdul Haris Nasution escaped an attack on his home.
en.n: The movement’s name refers to September 30; these killings took place on October 1.

zh.t: 印尼“九三〇运动”中六名陆军将领遇害
zh.s: 1965年10月1日凌晨，“九三〇运动”成员在雅加达杀害六名印度尼西亚陆军将领，包括陆军司令艾哈迈德·亚尼。阿卜杜勒·哈里斯·纳苏蒂安将军在住所遇袭后逃脱。
zh.n: 运动名称中的日期是9月30日，这些杀害事件发生在10月1日。

en.s: West Coast Airlines Flight 956 was a scheduled commercial flight in the Western United States which crashed on October 1, 1966, approximately 5.5 miles (9 km) south of Wemme, Oregon, southeast of Portland. Thirteen passengers and five crew members were aboard, but none survived. In its first week of service, the aircraft was destroyed by the impact and subsequent fire.

zh.t: 西海岸航空956号班机空难
zh.s: 西海岸航空956号班机是美国西部的一趟定期商业航班。1966年10月1日，飞机在俄勒冈州温梅以南约5.5英里（9公里）、波特兰东南方向坠毁。机上有13名乘客和5名机组人员，无人生还。该机投入运营仅一周，便因撞击及随后发生的火灾而毁坏。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Niger on 1 October 1970. The country was a one-party state at the time, with the Nigerien Progressive Party – African Democratic Rally as the sole legal party. Its leader, incumbent president Hamani Diori, was the only candidate, and was re-elected unopposed. Voter turnout was reported to be 98.3%.

zh.s: 尼日尔于1970年10月1日举行总统选举。当时该国实行一党制，尼日尔进步党—非洲民主联盟是唯一合法政党。该党领导人、时任总统哈马尼·迪奥里是唯一候选人，因此未经竞争便再次当选。官方公布的投票率为98.3%。

en.t: Walt Disney World opens near Orlando, Florida
en.s: Walt Disney World Resort (commonly known as Walt Disney World or Disney World) is an entertainment and vacation resort complex located about 20 miles (32 km) southwest of Orlando, Florida, United States. Opened on October 1, 1971, the resort is operated by Disney Experiences, a division of the Walt Disney Company.

zh.s: 华特迪士尼世界度假区通常简称华特迪士尼世界或迪士尼世界，是一座娱乐与度假综合园区，位于美国佛罗里达州奥兰多西南约20英里（32公里）处。度假区于1971年10月1日开园，由华特迪士尼公司旗下迪士尼体验部门运营。

en.s: The 1974 Tampa mayoral special election was held on October 1, 1974, following a primary election on September 10, 1974. Mayor Dick A. Greco, who was elected in 1967 and 1971, resigned on March 28, 1974, to accept a position with the Edward J. DeBartolo Corporation, a shopping mall developer. Following Greco's resignation, City Council Chairman Richard Cheney began serving as acting mayor.

zh.s: 1974年10月1日，坦帕举行市长特别选举，此前于9月10日举行初选。市长迪克·A·格雷科曾在1967年和1971年当选，后于1974年3月28日辞职，接受购物中心开发商爱德华·J·德巴托洛公司的职位。格雷科辞职后，市议会主席理查德·切尼开始担任代理市长。

en.t: In boxing, Muhammad Ali defeated Joe Frazier in a match known as the "Thrilla in Manila"
en.s: Muhammad Ali vs. Joe Frazier III, billed as the Thrilla in Manila, was the third and final boxing match between undisputed champion Muhammad Ali, and former champion Joe Frazier, for the undisputed heavyweight championship of the world. The bout was conceded after fourteen rounds on October 1, 1975, at the Araneta Coliseum in Cubao, Quezon City, Philippines, located in Rizal at the time of the event (later Metro Manila shortly after the event).

zh.t: 穆罕默德·阿里击败乔·弗雷泽，打出“马尼拉惊魂战”
zh.s: “马尼拉惊魂战”是穆罕默德·阿里与乔·弗雷泽第三次、也是最后一次拳击对决，比赛争夺无可争议的世界重量级冠军头衔。1975年10月1日，比赛在菲律宾奎松市库包的阿拉内塔体育馆举行（当时属黎刹省，赛后不久该地划归马尼拉大都会）。十四个回合后，弗雷泽一方认输。

en.t: Maccabi Tel Aviv wins the 1977 Israel Super Cup
en.s: On October 1, 1977, Maccabi Tel Aviv defeated Maccabi Jaffa 3–2 at Bloomfield Stadium in Tel Aviv to win the Israel Super Cup.

zh.s: 1977年10月1日，特拉维夫马卡比队在特拉维夫的布卢姆菲尔德球场以3比2击败雅法马卡比队，赢得以色列超级杯。

en.t: EPCOT Center (Experimental Prototype Community of Tomorrow) opens at Walt Disney World in Florida
en.s: Epcot (stylized in capital letters as EPCOT) is a theme park at Walt Disney World Resort in Bay Lake, Florida. Epcot is owned and operated by the Walt Disney Company through its Disney Experiences division. The park opened on October 1, 1982, as EPCOT Center—the second of four theme parks built at the resort.

zh.t: 未来世界中心（EPCOT Center）在佛罗里达州华特迪士尼世界开园
zh.s: 未来世界（Epcot，正式名称全部大写为EPCOT）是位于佛罗里达州湾湖华特迪士尼世界度假区内的一座主题乐园。乐园由华特迪士尼公司旗下迪士尼体验部门拥有并运营。它于1982年10月1日以“未来世界中心”（EPCOT Center）之名开园，是度假区四座主题乐园中的第二座。

en.t: Helmut Kohl is elected Chancellor of West Germany
en.s: On October 1, 1982, the Bundestag elected Helmut Kohl chancellor through a constructive vote of no confidence against Helmut Schmidt. The vote took place in Bonn, then the capital of West Germany.
en.n: This records the parliamentary change of chancellor, not the later general election.

zh.t: 赫尔穆特·科尔当选西德总理
zh.s: 1982年10月1日，联邦议院通过针对赫尔穆特·施密特的建设性不信任案，选举赫尔穆特·科尔为总理。表决在当时西德首都波恩举行。
zh.n: 这里记录议会更换总理，区别于此后举行的大选。

en.s: Soccer Bowl '83 was the 17th edition of the Soccer Bowl, the championship match of North American Soccer League (NASL), which took place on October 1, 1983. It was the final match of the 1983 North American Soccer League playoffs and was contested by the Tulsa Roughnecks and the Toronto Blizzard at the Stadium at BC Place in Vancouver, British Columbia.

zh.s: 1983年北美足球联赛冠军赛是第17届冠军赛，也是北美足球联赛（NASL）季后赛的决赛，于1983年10月1日举行。参赛队为塔尔萨粗人队和多伦多暴风雪队，比赛在不列颠哥伦比亚省温哥华的卑诗体育馆进行。

en.s: A referendum to confirm the presidential candidate Joseph Saidu Momoh was held in Sierra Leone on 1 October 1985. The country was a one-party state under the All People's Congress at the time, and only one candidate from that party was allowed. A referendum to approve the sole candidate was carried out in place of an election. It was the country's first direct vote for president.

zh.s: 1985年10月1日，塞拉利昂举行公投，确认总统候选人约瑟夫·赛杜·莫莫。当时该国由全民大会党实行一党制，只允许该党的一名候选人参选，因此以公投批准唯一候选人取代正式选举。这是塞拉利昂首次由全民直接投票选出总统。

en.s: Operation Wooden Leg (Hebrew: מבצע רגל עץ, Mivtza Regel Etz) was an Israeli airstrike on the Palestine Liberation Organization (PLO) headquarters in Hammam Chott, near Tunis, Tunisia, on 1 October 1985. With a target 1,280 miles (2,060 km) from the operation's starting point, this was the most distant publicly known action undertaken by the Israel Defense Forces since the Entebbe raid in 1976.

zh.s: 木腿行动（希伯来语：מבצע רגל עץ，罗马化：Mivtza Regel Etz）是以色列于1985年10月1日对突尼斯突尼斯附近哈马姆沙特的巴勒斯坦解放组织总部发动的一次空袭。目标距行动起点1280英里（2060公里），这是自1976年恩德培突袭以来，以色列国防军公开承认的最远距离军事行动。

en.s: The 1987 Whittier Narrows earthquake occurred in the southern San Gabriel Valley and surrounding communities of Southern California, United States, at 7:42 a.m. PDT on October 1. The moderate magnitude 5.9 blind thrust earthquake was centered several miles north of Whittier in the town of Rosemead, had a relatively shallow depth, and was felt throughout southern California and southern Nevada.

zh.s: 1987年10月1日太平洋夏令时间上午7时42分，美国加利福尼亚州南圣盖博谷及周边社区发生惠蒂尔海峡地震。震中位于惠蒂尔以北数英里、罗斯米德镇附近，震级为5.9级，属于中等强度的盲逆冲断层地震，震源较浅。南加州和内华达州南部均有震感。

en.s: The 1988 Victorian state election, held on Saturday, 1 October 1988, was for the 51st Parliament of Victoria. It was held in the Australian state of Victoria to elect all 88 members of the state's Legislative Assembly and 22 members of the 44-member Legislative Council. The incumbent Labor Party government led by Premier John Cain Jr. won a third term in office, despite a swing against it, and only lost the seat of Warrandyte in Melbourne's north-east.

zh.s: 1988年10月1日星期六，澳大利亚维多利亚州举行州选举，选出第51届议会议员，包括立法议会全部88名议员和由44人组成的立法委员会中的22名议员。时任工党政府由州长约翰·凯恩二世领导，尽管支持率有所下滑，仍赢得第三个任期，只在墨尔本东北部失去沃兰代特选区。

en.s: Tennis returned to the Summer Olympic Games at the 1988 Summer Olympics in Seoul, having been left out since the 1924 Summer Olympics in Paris. Tennis had been a demonstration sport at the 1968 and 1984 Summer Olympics. The tournament took place from September 20 – October 1 on outdoor hardcourts at the Seoul Olympic Park Tennis Center.

zh.s: 网球于1988年夏季奥运会重返奥运会，此前自1924年巴黎奥运会后便未列入正式比赛项目。1968年和1984年夏季奥运会期间，网球曾作为表演项目。比赛于9月20日至10月1日在首尔奥林匹克公园网球中心的室外硬地球场举行。

en.s: The Rwandan Civil War was a conflict within Rwanda, between the government of President Juvénal Habyarimana and the rebel Rwandan Patriotic Front (RPF). The conflict began on 1 October 1990 when the RPF invaded and ostensibly ended on 4 August 1993 with the signing of the Arusha Accords to create a power-sharing government. However, the assassination of Habyarimana in April 1994 proved to be the catalyst for the Rwandan Genocide, the commonly quoted death toll for which is 800,000. The closely interrelated causes of the war and genocide led some observers to assume that the reports of mass killings were in fact some new flaring of the war, rather than a different phase.

zh.s: 卢旺达内战是卢旺达政府与卢旺达爱国阵线（RPF）叛军之间的冲突。政府由总统朱韦纳尔·哈比亚利马纳领导。冲突于1990年10月1日随着爱国阵线入侵而开始，名义上于1993年8月4日签署《阿鲁沙协议》后结束，该协议旨在组建权力分享政府。不过，哈比亚利马纳于1994年4月遇刺，成为卢旺达种族灭绝的导火索，通常引用的死亡人数为80万。内战与种族灭绝的起因密切交织，一些观察者因此认为，大规模杀戮的报道实际上是内战新一轮升级，而非另一阶段。

en.s: The Siege of Dubrovnik (Croatian: Opsada Dubrovnika, Serbian Latin: Blokada Dubrovnika) was a military engagement fought between the Yugoslav People's Army (JNA) and Croatian forces defending the city of Dubrovnik and its surroundings during the Croatian War of Independence. The JNA started its advance on 1 October 1991 and by late October had captured virtually all of the territory between the Pelješac and Prevlaka peninsulas on the coast of the Adriatic Sea—except for Dubrovnik itself. The JNA attacks and bombardment of Dubrovnik, including the Old Town—a UNESCO World Heritage Site—culminated on 6 December 1991.

zh.s: 杜布罗夫尼克围城战（克罗地亚语：Opsada Dubrovnika；塞尔维亚拉丁字母写法：Blokada Dubrovnika）是克罗地亚独立战争期间南斯拉夫人民军（JNA）与保卫杜布罗夫尼克及周边地区的克罗地亚部队之间的一场军事交战。南斯拉夫人民军于1991年10月1日开始推进，到10月下旬，已攻占佩列沙茨半岛与普雷夫拉卡半岛之间亚得里亚海沿岸几乎所有地区，只有杜布罗夫尼克仍未攻下。对杜布罗夫尼克及其旧城（联合国教科文组织世界遗产）的进攻和炮击于1991年12月6日达到高潮。

en.s: The CMLL 60th Anniversary Show was a professional wrestling major show event produced by Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL) that took place on October 1, 1993 in Arena México, Mexico City, Mexico. The show consisted of four matches, with the main event being a Lucha de Apuestas, mask vs. mask match, between Atlantis defeated Mano Negra where the loser would be forced to unmask. The show featured an additional Lucha de Apuesta match, this one under "Hair vs. hair" stipulations as Negro Casas faced La Fiera. The show also featured two Six-man tag team matches.

zh.s: CMLL成立60周年纪念赛是由世界摔角理事会（CMLL）主办的大型职业摔角赛事，于1993年10月1日在墨西哥城墨西哥竞技场举行。赛事共有四场比赛。主赛是“面具对面具”的赌注赛，亚特兰蒂斯击败马诺·内格拉；败者必须摘下面具。赛事还安排了一场“头发对头发”的赌注赛，由内格罗·卡萨斯对阵拉菲耶拉，并包括两场六人组队赛。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Slovakia on 30 September and 1 October 1994. The early elections were necessary after the Vladimír Mečiar 1992 government had been recalled in March 1994 by the National Council and a new temporary government under Jozef Moravčík had been created at the same time. The governing Movement for a Democratic Slovakia (HZDS) lost seats, but remained the largest party in the National Council with over three times as many seats as the second-placed Common Choice, a left-wing alliance, which almost failed to enter the parliament despite its good performance in pre-election opinion polls.

zh.s: 斯洛伐克于1994年9月30日和10月1日举行议会选举。1992年弗拉基米尔·梅恰尔政府于1994年3月被国民议会撤换，并同时成立约瑟夫·莫拉夫奇克领导的临时政府，因此需要提前举行选举。执政的争取民主斯洛伐克运动（HZDS）虽失去席位，仍是国民议会第一大党，席位数超过第二名左翼联盟“共同选择”的三倍。尽管选前民调表现不错，“共同选择”仍差点未能进入议会。

en.s: The 1994 Shreveport mayoral election resulted in the election of Republican councilman Robert W. "Bo" Williams in the race to succeed incumbent Hazel Beard. en.s: The 1995 Portuguese legislative election took place on 1 October. The election renewed all 230 members of the Assembly of the Republic. The incumbent prime minister, Aníbal Cavaco Silva, decided not to run for a fourth consecutive term, and the Social Democratic Party choose Fernando Nogueira, one of Cavaco Silva's deputies, as leader and candidate for prime minister at a highly contested and bitter party congress in February 1995.

en.s: The 2006 general election for the National Council in Austria was held on 1 October 2006. Following the Austrian legislative election, 1999, the Austrian People's Party (ÖVP) had formed a coalition government with the Austrian Freedom Party (FPÖ), and later the Alliance for the Future of Austria (BZÖ). As a result of the 2006 election, the ÖVP-BZÖ coalition lost their majority in parliament. After three months of negotiations, it was announced on January 8 that the SPÖ and ÖVP would form a grand coalition, with SPÖ leader Alfred Gusenbauer becoming the next Chancellor.

zh.s: 奥地利于2006年10月1日举行国民议会大选。1999年议会选举后，奥地利人民党（ÖVP）先后与奥地利自由党（FPÖ）和奥地利未来联盟（BZÖ）组成联合政府。2006年选举后，ÖVP—BZÖ联盟失去议会多数。经过三个月谈判，宣布由奥地利社会民主党（SPÖ）和ÖVP组成大联合政府，SPÖ领导人阿尔弗雷德·古森鲍尔将出任下一任总理。

en.s: W.A.K.O. World Championships 2007 in Belgrade were the joint 16th edition of the W.A.K.O. world championships - the second event would be held later that year in Coimbra, Portugal. They were for amateur male and female kickboxers and covered the following categories; K-1, Low-Kick and Light-Contact. Weight classes for men ranged from light bantamweight (51 kg or 112 lb) to super heavyweight (over 91 kg or 200.6 lb), while the women's ranged from featherweight (52 kg or 114.6 lb) to super heavyweight (over 70 kg or 154 lb). More information on the categories, weight classes and rules is provided in the various sections below.

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Georgia on 1 October 2012. The opposition Georgian Dream coalition of billionaire businessman Bidzina Ivanishvili won a majority of the seats. en.t: The American cargo vessel SS El Faro sinks with all of its 33 crew after steaming into the eyewall of Hurricane Joaquin
en.s: SS El Faro was a United States-flagged, combination of roll-on/roll-off and lift-on/lift-off cargo ship crewed by U.S. merchant mariners. Built in 1975 by Sun Shipbuilding & Drydock Co. as Puerto Rico, the vessel was renamed Northern Lights in 1991 and, finally, El Faro in 2006. en.s: The 2025 Campeones Cup was the seventh edition of the Campeones Cup, an annual North American soccer match contested between the reigning champion of MLS Cup of the Major League Soccer (MLS) and the winner of the Campeón de Campeones of Liga MX. The match featured the LA Galaxy, winners of the 2024 MLS Cup, and Toluca, the winners of the 2025 Campeón de Campeones.

zh.s: 2025年冠军之杯是该项赛事的第七届。冠军之杯是北美年度足球比赛，由美国职业足球大联盟（MLS）杯赛卫冕冠军对阵墨西哥足球甲级联赛冠军对冠军（Campeón de Campeones）的胜者。本届参赛队为2024年MLS杯冠军洛杉矶银河和2025年Campeón de Campeones冠军托卢卡。
